purpose: Separate, machine-verifiable decision evidence for finalized Shine Defence review candidates.

outcomes.meaning: The candidate was promoted into the canonical reviewed ledger and certification receipt.
A newer candidate replaced this candidate before review completed.
The candidate was closed without certification.

rules: Every finalized review candidate must have exactly one decision record.
A pending_review candidate must not have a decision record.
The decision candidate id, app id and outcome must exactly match the review-candidate queue.
A decision timestamp must not predate the candidate observation timestamp.
Accepted candidates remain subject to the canonical reviewed-ledger and certification-receipt equality checks.
A superseded decision must name the same successor candidate recorded by the review-candidate queue, and that successor must belong to the same app.
Decision identifiers are deterministic: candidateId plus '-' plus outcome.
Decision authority and summary text are bounded, non-empty and must not contain obvious credentials or private-key material.
Decision records do not grant or extend the Protected by Shine Defence badge; certification authority remains the canonical reviewed ledger plus an exact certification receipt.
nonClaims: A review decision is not a cryptographic signature.
A dismissed or superseded decision does not imply the release is unsafe.
A recorded acceptance does not certify later revisions of the application.
